activities.activity_name: Create EC2 AMI for Kafka Perf Tests
activities.activity_description: Design and create an AWS EC2 AMI containing all necessary packages (Java, Kafka, dependencies) to run Kafka performance tests. Includes selecting base AMI, installing software, testing, and documenting the process.
Develop a source module that generates synthetic load for Kafka performance testing. Includes design, implementation, unit and integration tests.
Develop a sink module that receives messages from Kafka and measures throughput for performance testing. Includes design, implementation, and testing.
Set up continuous integration pipeline for Windows builds to verify XD runtime features. Configure build scripts, experiment with AMI images to isolate test failures, and document the pipeline.

activities.activity_name: Fix Offset Management in Kafka Source Module
activities.activity_description: Analyze and fix the offset management logic in the Kafka source module to enable efficient fetch operations from given offsets. Includes code changes, testing, and validation.
Design and execute performance measurements for a simple stream using the source and sink modules. Collect throughput data, analyze results, and document findings.
Set up and populate a static GitHub Pages site (using Jekyll) with organized collateral: samples, tutorials, links, performance benchmarks, and reference architectures related to XD.

activities.activity_name: Continue Lattice/Diego POC for Pluggable SPI
activities.activity_description: Continue the proof-of-concept for Lattice/Diego integration to identify scope, risks, and overall design for a pluggable SPI in the XD runtime. Includes research, prototyping, and documenting findings.
